headlines.title: Starbucks unveils limited-time collection exclusive to Target
headlines.summary: The limited-time items’ cute theme gives shoppers another reason to stop by their local store.

headlines.title: 3 Reasons to Avoid SBUX and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
headlines.summary: Over the past six months, Starbucks’s stock price fell to $91.86. Shareholders have lost 6.7% of their capital, which is disappointing considering the S&P 500 has climbed by 12%. This might have investors contemplating their next move.

headlines.title: Starbucks (SBUX) Refocuses On Its Turnaround Plan, Is The 18% Undervalued View Enough?
headlines.summary: Starbucks (SBUX) is back in the spotlight after reports it explored a possible takeover of Chipotle Mexican Grill. The coffee chain is now emphasizing its focus on the Back to Starbucks turnaround plan. Recent headlines have arrived against a choppy backdrop for Starbucks shares. The stock has slipped over the past week and month, with the 7-day share price return down 4.28% and the 30-day share price return down 6.83%, while the year-to-date share price return is up 9.

headlines.title: Starbucks Just Hiked Its Dividend by 1.6%. Here’s Why It’s Still Not an Obvious ‘Buy.’
headlines.summary: Starbucks raised its quarterly dividend by about 1.6% to $0.63 per share ahead of its Oct. 29 fiscal fourth-quarter report, after global comparable sales rose 7.9% in the prior quarter.

headlines.title: What Target (TGT)'s Vintage Brand Revival and Tech Upgrades Mean For Shareholders
headlines.summary: In early October 2026, Target brought back its Simply Shabby Chic home brand with a vintage-inspired bedding and seasonal decor line, and continued expanding exclusive in-store offerings like the Starbucks x Target Cake Pop Collection at accessible price points.

description: Starbucks Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a roaster, marketer, and retailer of coffee internationally. The company operates through three segments: North America, International, and Channel Development. Its stores offer coffee, tea, and other beverages, roasted whole beans and ground coffees, complementary food, packaged coffees, single-serve products, and ready-to-drink beverages; and various food products, such as pastries, breakfast sandwiches, and lunch items. The company also licenses its trademarks through licensed stores, and grocery and foodservice accounts. The company offers its products under the Starbucks Coffee, Teavana, Seattle's Best Coffee, Ethos, and Starbucks Reserve brands. Starbucks Corporation was founded in 1971 and is based in Seattle, Washington.
